The '''Krandt brothers''' were a pair of B-grade,<ref name="The Hard Way" /> [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]<ref name="Rulebook" /> [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] discovered them on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and learned that they might have information on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and how he could be rescued from [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="The Hard Way" />
